_comment: Mississippi 2026 QAP, Mississippi Home Corporation. Page numbers are PDF page indices, matching the printed page numbers. Every page's running header reads '2024 QUALIFIED ALLOCATION PLAN', but p.5 records 'adoption of the 2026 Qualified Allocation Plan' and the p.19 schedule runs in 2026; the header is stale, recorded not resolved. Scoring is Addendum A (pp.62-76). Competitive applications need 85 points and bond applications 80 (p.62). NO TOTAL IS STATED. Hand-summed before loading from the section maxima: Site Location 10 (two of four, capped), Building Standards 7, Development Amenities 6, Unit Amenities 10, Development Type 25 (new construction 10 or acquisition/rehabilitation 25), Deeper Targeting 5, Special Needs 13 (one category), Development Experience 13, Management Experience 20, and +5 from the construction cost adjustment = 114. The loader matched. Deductions are excluded, and three have no maximum. Thresholds (Section 4) are in MS_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: No total stated. Computed 114: the section maxima total 109, plus 5 from the MCC adjustment, which can add as well as deduct. Minimums are 85 (competitive) and 80 (bond).
